```{r setup}
study_1a_names <- c(`1` = "Control-Duration Test", `2` = "Blocked-Duration Test", `3` = "Control-F0 Test", `4` = "Blocked-F0 Test")
study_1b_names <- c(`1` = "Stop predictive-L1 F0", `2` = "Stop predictive-L2 F0", `3` = "Stop nonpredictive-L2 F0", 
    `4` = "Stop removed-L2 F0")
study_1b_labels <- setNames(sub("-L", "-\nL", study_1b_names, fixed = TRUE), names(study_1b_names))
label_1b_terms <- function(x, reference = "1", contrasts = FALSE) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- gsub("C1_C2", paste0("mean(", study_1b_names["1"], " + ", study_1b_names["2"], ")"), x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("C3_C4", paste0("mean(", study_1b_names["3"], " + ", study_1b_names["4"], ")"), x, fixed = TRUE)
    for (k in 4:1) {
        x <- gsub(paste0("factor(condition)", k), if (contrasts) 
            study_1b_names[as.character(k)]
        else paste0(study_1b_names[as.character(k)], " vs. ", study_1b_names[reference]), x, fixed = TRUE)
        x <- gsub(paste0("condition", k), if (contrasts) 
            study_1b_names[as.character(k)]
        else paste0(study_1b_names[as.character(k)], " vs. ", study_1b_names[reference]), x, fixed = TRUE)
        x <- gsub(paste0("Condition ", k), study_1b_names[as.character(k)], x, fixed = TRUE)
        x <- gsub(paste0("C", k), study_1b_names[as.character(k)], x, fixed = TRUE)
    }
    x <- gsub("_vs_", " vs. ", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("stop_tone_alignment", "Alignment ", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("Alignment Aligned", "Aligned vs. misaligned", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("Alignment Misaligned", "Misaligned vs. aligned", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("cue_type", "AX ", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub(":", " × ", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x[x == "grouping"] <- "Nonpredictive/removed stop vs. predictive stop"
    x
}
wrap_display <- function(x, width = 55) vapply(x, function(z) paste(strwrap(z, width = width), collapse = "\n"), 
    character(1))
study_1b_axis_labels <- setNames(sub("Stop ", "Stop\n", study_1b_labels, fixed = TRUE), names(study_1b_labels))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, error = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r paths}
project_dir <- Sys.getenv("ADAPT_PROJECT_DIR", ".")
project_dir <- normalizePath(project_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
target_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data", "exp_1b")
output_dir <- file.path(target_dir, "analysis")
figure_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Adapt", "figures_completed", "study_1b")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
run_models <- TRUE
run_eye_tracking <- FALSE
export_roots <- c(target_dir, file.path(project_dir, "data", "exp_2"))
data_folders <- unlist(lapply(export_roots, list.dirs, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE))
data_folders <- data_folders[grepl("^data_exp_278863-v[0-9]+$", basename(data_folders))]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(basename(data_folders)))
folder_csv_files <- unlist(lapply(data_folders, list.files, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))
spread_directories <- file.path(target_dir, c("spread_data_5", "spread_data"))
spread_csv_files <- unlist(lapply(spread_directories, function(directory) {
    if (dir.exists(directory)) 
        list.files(directory, pattern = "^data_exp_278863-v[0-9]+_.*[.]csv$", full.names = TRUE)
    else character()
}))
import_files <- tibble(path = c(spread_csv_files, folder_csv_files)) %>% mutate(source_file = basename(path), selected = !duplicated(source_file))
csv_files <- import_files$path[import_files$selected]
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(import_files, file.path(output_dir, "import_file_selection.csv"))
raw_data_available <- length(csv_files) > 0
data_available <- FALSE
ax_raw <- tibble()
ax <- tibble()
```

```{r raw-import}
all_data <- tibble()
if (raw_data_available) {
    list_of_data_frames <- lapply(csv_files, function(file) {
        read_csv(file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(source_file = basename(file))
    })
    all_data <- bind_rows(list_of_data_frames) %>% filter(!is.na(`Participant Private ID`), !is.na(`Experiment Version`))
} else {
    message("Waiting for Gorilla CSVs in extracted export folders or spread_data under: ", target_dir)
}
```

```{r task-import}
if (raw_data_available) {
    consent <- all_data %>% filter(grepl("questionnaire-5xbh", source_file))
    warning_page <- all_data %>% filter(grepl("questionnaire-9q6z", source_file))
    headphones <- all_data %>% filter(grepl("task-8jc2", source_file))
    et_test <- all_data %>% filter(grepl("task-d4xf", source_file))
    digit_span <- all_data %>% filter(grepl("task-2wd9", source_file))
    language_experience <- all_data %>% filter(grepl("questionnaire-zc55", source_file))
    ax_instructions <- all_data %>% filter(grepl("task-(sr8v|n7re)", source_file))
    s_exp1b <- all_data %>% filter(grepl("task-(fc2b|wjfw|719h|eqie|ci5b|qhmu|o6s4|kosn)", source_file))
    ax_raw <- all_data %>% filter(condition %in% c("list_tone", "list_tone_stopless", "list_VOT"))
    event_inventory <- s_exp1b %>% count(`Tree Node Key`, display, `Screen Name`, `Zone Type`)
    response_events <- s_exp1b %>% filter(`Screen Name` == "Screen 3", display %in% c("practice", "testing"), `Zone Type` %in% 
        c("response_button_image", "timelimit_screen"))
    data <- response_events %>% mutate(participant = `Participant Private ID`, session = paste(`Experiment Version`, 
        `Schedule ID`, sep = "_"), task = paste(`Tree Node Key`, coalesce(`Repeat Key`, ""), sep = "_"), trial = `Spreadsheet Row`, 
        item = item_id, response = if_else(`Zone Type` == "timelimit_screen", NA_character_, Response), answer = case_when(ANSWER == 
            "q1" ~ q1, ANSWER == "q2" ~ q2, ANSWER == "q3" ~ q3, ANSWER == "q4" ~ q4), target_image = target, competitor_image = competitor, 
        rt_ms = as.numeric(`Reaction Time`), trial_order = as.numeric(`Trial Number`), condition = condition_number, 
        expected_condition = case_when(grepl("task-(fc2b|ci5b)", source_file) ~ "1", grepl("task-(wjfw|qhmu)", 
            source_file) ~ "2", grepl("task-(719h|o6s4)", source_file) ~ "3", grepl("task-(eqie|kosn)", source_file) ~ 
            "4"), phase = if_else(display == "practice", "training", "testing"), phase = factor(phase, levels = c("training", 
            "testing"), ordered = TRUE))
    stopifnot(nrow(data) > 0, all(data$condition == data$expected_condition), all(data$answer == data$target), 
        !anyNA(data$item))
    condition_key <- data %>% distinct(participant, `Experiment Version`, condition)
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(condition_key[c("participant", "Experiment Version")]))
    ax <- ax_raw %>% filter(display == "trial", `Screen Name` == "Screen 3", `Zone Type` %in% c("response_keyboard", 
        "timelimit_screen", "continue_button")) %>% mutate(participant = `Participant Private ID`, session = paste(`Experiment Version`, 
        `Schedule ID`, sep = "_"), task = paste(`Tree Node Key`, coalesce(`Repeat Key`, ""), sep = "_"), trial = `Spreadsheet Row`, 
        response = if_else(`Zone Type` != "response_keyboard", NA_character_, tolower(Response)), answer = case_when(tolower(ANSWER) %in% 
            c("same", "z") ~ "z", tolower(ANSWER) %in% c("different", "m") ~ "m"), rt_ms = as.numeric(`Reaction Time`), 
        occasion = "post", ax_list = condition, cue_type = case_when(ax_list == "list_tone" ~ "F0 intact", ax_list == 
            "list_tone_stopless" ~ "F0 stopless", ax_list == "list_VOT" ~ "VOT"), cue_type = factor(cue_type, levels = c("F0 intact", 
            "F0 stopless", "VOT"))) %>% select(-condition) %>% left_join(condition_key, by = c("participant", "Experiment Version"))
    stopifnot(!anyNA(ax$condition), !anyNA(ax$answer), !anyNA(ax$cue_type))
    data_available <- TRUE
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = data_available)
```

```{r participant-review}
part_agg <- data %>% group_by(participant, condition, phase) %>% summarise(trials = n(), missing_response = sum(is.na(response) | 
    response == ""), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(part_agg, file.path(output_dir, "participant_trial_counts.csv"))
rt_participant_quality <- data %>% filter(!is.na(response), response != "", is.finite(rt_ms), rt_ms > 0) %>% mutate(log_rt = log(rt_ms)) %>% 
    group_by(participant, condition, phase) %>% summarise(median_rt_ms = median(rt_ms), median_log_rt = median(log_rt), 
    .groups = "drop") %>% group_by(condition, phase) %>% mutate(group_median_log_rt = median(median_log_rt), group_mad_log_rt = mad(median_log_rt, 
    constant = 1.4826), phase_rt_outlier = group_mad_log_rt > 0 & abs(median_log_rt - group_median_log_rt) > 3 * 
    group_mad_log_rt) %>% ungroup()
participant_rt_exclusions <- rt_participant_quality %>% group_by(participant, condition) %>% summarise(rt_outlier_phases = sum(phase_rt_outlier), 
    rt_quality_exclude = rt_outlier_phases >= 1, .groups = "drop")
write_csv(rt_participant_quality, file.path(output_dir, "participant_rt_quality_by_phase.csv"))
write_csv(participant_rt_exclusions, file.path(output_dir, "participant_rt_quality_exclusions.csv"))
review_file <- file.path(target_dir, "participant_review.csv")
if (file.exists(review_file)) {
    participant_review <- read_csv(review_file, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(participant = col_character(), 
        exclude = col_logical(), reason = col_character()))
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(participant_review$participant))
    participant_review <- data %>% distinct(participant) %>% left_join(participant_review, by = "participant")
} else {
    participant_review <- data %>% distinct(participant) %>% mutate(exclude = FALSE, reason = "Retained: no RT-quality exclusion")
}
participant_review <- data %>% distinct(participant) %>% left_join(participant_review, by = "participant") %>% 
    left_join(participant_rt_exclusions %>% select(participant, rt_outlier_phases, rt_quality_exclude), by = "participant") %>% 
    mutate(rt_outlier_phases = coalesce(rt_outlier_phases, 0L), rt_quality_exclude = coalesce(rt_quality_exclude, 
        FALSE), exclude = coalesce(exclude, FALSE) | rt_quality_exclude, reason = case_when(rt_quality_exclude ~ 
        paste0("RT-quality exclusion: median log-RT beyond 3 scaled MADs in either training or testing", if_else(!is.na(reason) & 
            !reason %in% c("", "CHECK HERE", "Retained: no RT-quality exclusion"), paste0("; existing review: ", 
            reason), "")), is.na(reason) | reason == "" | reason == "CHECK HERE" ~ "Retained: no RT-quality exclusion", 
        TRUE ~ reason))
stopifnot(all(!participant_review$exclude | (!is.na(participant_review$reason) & participant_review$reason != "")))
part_keep <- participant_review %>% filter(!exclude)
removal <- data %>% distinct(participant, condition) %>% left_join(participant_review, by = "participant") %>% 
    count(condition, exclude, reason, name = "participants")
write_csv(removal, file.path(output_dir, "participant_removal.csv"))
participant_retention_counts <- data %>% distinct(participant, condition) %>% left_join(participant_review, by = "participant") %>% 
    group_by(condition) %>% summarise(before = n(), rt_excluded = sum(rt_quality_exclude), excluded = sum(exclude), 
    retained = sum(!exclude), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(participant_review, file.path(output_dir, "participant_review_applied.csv"))
write_csv(participant_retention_counts, file.path(output_dir, "participant_retention_counts.csv"))
if (file.exists(file.path(output_dir, "participant_review_to_complete.csv"))) file.remove(file.path(output_dir, 
    "participant_review_to_complete.csv"))
```

```{r behavioral-cleanup}
mad_standard <- 3
data_cleaned <- data %>% filter(participant %in% part_keep$participant) %>% mutate(missing_response = is.na(response) | 
    response == "", missing_answer = is.na(answer) | answer == "", correct = if_else(missing_response | missing_answer, 
    NA_integer_, as.integer(response == answer)), log_rt = if_else(is.finite(rt_ms) & rt_ms > 0, log(pmax(rt_ms, 
    0.001)), NA_real_))
accuracy_data <- data_cleaned %>% filter(!is.na(correct))
rt_data <- accuracy_data %>% filter(correct == 1, is.finite(log_rt), rt_ms > 0) %>% group_by(participant, task, 
    phase) %>% mutate(median_rt = median(log_rt), abs_distance = abs(log_rt - median_rt), median_distance = median(abs_distance), 
    rt_outlier = if_else(n() >= 5 & median_distance > 0, abs_distance > mad_standard * median_distance, FALSE)) %>% 
    ungroup()
write_csv(rt_data %>% select(participant, session, task, trial, rt_ms, rt_outlier), file.path(output_dir, "rt_screening.csv"))
rt_data <- rt_data %>% filter(!rt_outlier)
trial_removal <- data_cleaned %>% group_by(condition, phase) %>% summarise(total = n(), missing_response = sum(missing_response), 
    missing_answer = sum(missing_answer), accuracy_retained = sum(!is.na(correct)), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(trial_removal, file.path(output_dir, "trial_retention.csv"))
write_csv(accuracy_data, file.path(output_dir, "accuracy_data.csv"))
```

```{r ax-scoring}
ax_available <- nrow(ax) > 0
ax_scores <- tibble()
if (ax_available) {
    ax <- ax %>% mutate(participant = as.character(participant), condition = as.character(condition)) %>% filter(participant %in% 
        part_keep$participant)
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ax[c("participant", "session", "task", "trial")]), all(ax$answer %in% c("z", "m")))
    ax <- ax %>% mutate(missing_ax_response = !response %in% c("z", "m"), too_fast = !missing_ax_response & is.finite(rt_ms) & 
        rt_ms < 0, invalid_rt = !missing_ax_response & (!is.finite(rt_ms) | rt_ms > 1500), usable = !missing_ax_response & 
        is.finite(rt_ms) & rt_ms >= 0 & rt_ms <= 1500, hit = usable & answer == "m" & response == "m", false_alarm = usable & 
        answer == "z" & response == "m")
    ax_scores <- ax %>% group_by(participant, condition, language, cue_type, occasion) %>% summarise(total = n(), 
        omissions = sum(missing_ax_response), too_fast = sum(too_fast), invalid_rt = sum(invalid_rt), excluded = sum(!usable), 
        n_different = sum(usable & answer == "m"), n_same = sum(usable & answer == "z"), hits = sum(hit), false_alarms = sum(false_alarm), 
        .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(hit_rate = (hits + 0.5)/(n_different + 1), fa_rate = (false_alarms + 0.5)/(n_same + 
        1), dprime = if_else(n_different > 0 & n_same > 0, qnorm(hit_rate) - qnorm(fa_rate), NA_real_), bias = if_else(n_different > 
        0 & n_same > 0, -0.5 * (qnorm(hit_rate) + qnorm(fa_rate)), NA_real_))
    stopifnot(all(ax_scores$total == ax_scores$n_same + ax_scores$n_different + ax_scores$excluded), all(ax_scores$excluded == 
        ax_scores$omissions + ax_scores$too_fast + ax_scores$invalid_rt))
    write_csv(ax %>% select(participant, condition, cue_type, session, task, trial, response, answer, rt_ms, missing_ax_response, 
        too_fast, invalid_rt, usable), file.path(output_dir, "ax_trial_screening.csv"))
    write_csv(ax_scores, file.path(output_dir, "ax_sensitivity.csv"))
    ax_accuracy <- ax %>% group_by(participant, condition, cue_type) %>% summarise(trials = n(), omissions = sum(missing_ax_response), 
        too_fast = sum(too_fast), invalid_rt = sum(invalid_rt), excluded = sum(!usable), accuracy = if (any(usable)) 
            mean(response[usable] == answer[usable])
        else NA_real_, .groups = "drop")
    write_csv(ax_accuracy, file.path(output_dir, "ax_accuracy.csv"))
    ax_limits <- range(c(0, ax_scores$dprime), na.rm = TRUE)
    for (cue in levels(ax$cue_type)) {
    }
    ax_inventory <- ax %>% group_by(`Experiment Version`, `Tree Node Key`, ax_list, cue_type) %>% summarise(participants = n_distinct(participant), 
        trials = n(), omissions = sum(missing_ax_response), too_fast = sum(too_fast), invalid_rt = sum(invalid_rt), 
        excluded = sum(!usable), .groups = "drop")
    write_csv(ax_inventory, file.path(output_dir, "ax_task_inventory.csv"))
}
```

```{r lexical-cue-analysis}
stop_key <- data %>% filter(phase == "training", condition %in% c("1", "2")) %>% mutate(base_word = sub("_[0-9]+.*$", 
    "", word), frame = substring(base_word, 2), stop = substring(base_word, 1, 1)) %>% distinct(participant, `Experiment Version`,

    "", word), frame = substring(base_word, 2), stop = substring(base_word, 1, 1), tone_image = target_image) %>% 
    left_join(stop_key, by = c("participant", "Experiment Version", "condition", "frame", "stop")) %>% mutate(cue_relation = case_when(condition %in% 
    c("3", "4") ~ "No trained stop mapping", tone_image == stop_image ~ "Matching", tone_image != stop_image ~ 
    "Conflicting"), tone_consistent = if_else(missing_response, NA_integer_, as.integer(response == tone_image)), 
    stop_consistent = if_else(missing_response | is.na(stop_image), NA_integer_, as.integer(response == stop_image)), 
    response_choice = case_when(missing_response ~ "Omission", cue_relation == "Matching" & tone_consistent == 
        1L ~ "Both cues", tone_consistent == 1L ~ "Tone", stop_consistent == 1L ~ "Stop", TRUE ~ "Other picture")) %>% 
    left_join(pilot_key, by = "participant")
stopifnot(!anyNA(test_cues$cue_relation), all(!is.na(test_cues$stop_image[test_cues$condition %in% c("1", "2")])), 
    all(test_cues$stop_image[test_cues$cue_relation == "Conflicting"] == test_cues$competitor_image[test_cues$cue_relation == 
        "Conflicting"]))
```

```{r overall-tone-model}

    data = test_data, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e+05)))

    adjust = "holm")

write_csv(as.data.frame(tone_contrasts_out), file.path(output_dir, "tone_model_contrasts.csv"))
```

```{r rq12-model-selection-setup}
rq12_fit <- function(d, label) {
    d <- d %>% mutate(condition = droplevels(factor(condition)), stop_tone_alignment = factor(stop_tone_alignment, 
        levels = c("Misaligned", "Aligned")), participant = factor(participant), item = factor(item), a = as.numeric(stop_tone_alignment == 
        "Aligned"))
    stopifnot(!anyNA(d), all(d$correct %in% 0:1))
    stopifnot(all(tapply(d$condition, d$participant, function(x) n_distinct(x)) == 1), all(tapply(d$a, d$participant, 
        function(x) n_distinct(x)) == 2), all(tapply(d$condition, d$item, function(x) n_distinct(x)) == nlevels(d$condition)), 
        all(tapply(d$a, d$item, function(x) n_distinct(x)) == 2))
    slopes <- paste0("c", levels(d$condition)[-1])
    for (j in seq_along(slopes)) d[[slopes[j]]] <- as.numeric(d$condition == levels(d$condition)[j + 1])
    main <- paste(c(slopes, "a"), collapse = "+")
    full <- paste(c(slopes, "a", paste0(slopes, ":a")), collapse = "+")
    rhs <- c(maximal_correlated = paste0("(1+a|participant)+(1+", full, "|item)"), maximal_independent = paste0("(1+a||participant)+(1+", 
        full, "||item)"), main_slopes_correlated = paste0("(1+a|participant)+(1+", main, "|item)"), main_slopes_independent = paste0("(1+a||participant)+(1+", 
        main, "||item)"), condition_item_slopes = paste0("(1+a||participant)+(1+", paste(slopes, collapse = "+"), 
        "||item)"), alignment_slopes = "(1+a||participant)+(1+a||item)", participant_alignment = "(1+a||participant)+(1|item)", 
        random_intercepts = "(1|participant)+(1|item)")
    fits <- list()
    rows <- list()
    for (nm in names(rhs)) {
        formula <- as.formula(paste("correct~condition*stop_tone_alignment+", rhs[[nm]]))
        key <- list(data = as.data.frame(d), formula = paste(deparse(formula), collapse = ""), optimizer = "bobyqa", 
            maxfun = 2e+05, nAGQ = 1, lme4 = as.character(packageVersion("lme4")))
        cache <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(label, "_candidate_", nm, ".rds"))
        previous <- if (file.exists(cache)) 
            readRDS(cache)
        else NULL
        if (!is.null(previous) && identical(previous$key, key)) 
            result <- previous$result
        else {
            message(label, ": fitting ", nm)
            warnings <- character()
            fit <- withCallingHandlers(tryCatch(glmer(formula, data = d, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
                optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e+05))), error = function(e) e), warning = function(w) {
                warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
                invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
            })
            result <- list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings))
            saveRDS(list(key = key, result = result), cache)
        }
        fit <- result$fit
        fitted <- inherits(fit, "merMod")
        conv <- if (fitted) 
            fit@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
        else character()
        convergence_issues <- conv[!grepl("boundary (singular) fit", conv, fixed = TRUE)]
        converged <- fitted && length(convergence_issues) == 0 && all(fit@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)
        fits[[nm]] <- fit
        rows[[nm]] <- tibble(candidate = nm, random_effects = rhs[[nm]], fitted = fitted, converged = converged, 
            singular = if (fitted) 
                isSingular(fit)
            else NA, AIC = if (fitted) 
                AIC(fit)
            else NA_real_, BIC = if (fitted) 
                BIC(fit)
            else NA_real_, diagnostic = if (fitted) 
                paste(c(result$warnings, conv), collapse = "; ")
            else conditionMessage(fit))
        write_csv(bind_rows(rows), file.path(output_dir, paste0(label, "_random_effects_selection.csv")))
    }
    selection <- bind_rows(rows) %>% mutate(eligible = fitted & converged & !singular)
    if (!any(selection$eligible)) 
        stop(label, ": no converged nonsingular candidate; inspect diagnostics.")
    selected <- selection %>% filter(eligible) %>% slice_min(AIC, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(candidate)
    selection <- selection %>% mutate(selected = candidate == selected, delta_AIC = if_else(eligible, AIC - min(AIC[eligible]), 
        NA_real_))
    model <- fits[[selected]]
    write_csv(selection, file.path(output_dir, paste0(label, "_random_effects_selection.csv")))
    saveRDS(model, file.path(output_dir, paste0(label, "_model.rds")))
    list(model = model, selection = selection)
}
```

```{r rq1-c2-reference}
rq1_c2_check <- data.frame(observations_original = nobs(mod_rq1), observations_c2 = nobs(mod_rq1_c2), logLik_original = as.numeric(logLik(mod_rq1)), 
    logLik_c2 = as.numeric(logLik(mod_rq1_c2)), max_fitted_difference = max(abs(fitted(mod_rq1) - fitted(mod_rq1_c2))), 
    singular = isSingular(mod_rq1_c2), convergence = paste(mod_rq1_c2@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages, collapse = "; "))
stopifnot(nobs(mod_rq1) == nobs(mod_rq1_c2), abs(as.numeric(logLik(mod_rq1) - logLik(mod_rq1_c2))) < 0.01, rq1_c2_check$max_fitted_difference < 
    0.001)

    qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`, upper_95 = Estimate + qnorm(0.975) * `Std. Error`)

write_csv(rq1_c2_check, file.path(output_dir, "rq1_c2_fit_check.csv"))
```

```{r rq3-information-data}
rq3_info_path <- file.path(output_dir, "rq3_training_information_k2_snapshot.csv")
rq3_info <- read_csv(rq3_info_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(k == 2, metric %in% c("F0 alone", "VOT alone", 
    "Shared information (net)")) %>% mutate(condition = as.character(condition), metric = recode(metric, `F0 alone` = "f0_info", 
    `VOT alone` = "vot_info", `Shared information (net)` = "shared_info")) %>% select(condition, vowel_family, 
    metric, estimate_bits) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = estimate_bits)
stopifnot(nrow(rq3_info) == 16, !anyDuplicated(rq3_info[c("condition", "vowel_family")]))
rq3_scaling <- tibble(variable = c("f0_info", "vot_info", "shared_info")) %>% mutate(center = sapply(variable, 
    function(x) mean(rq3_info[[x]])), scale = sapply(variable, function(x) sd(rq3_info[[x]])))
for (x in rq3_scaling$variable) rq3_info[[paste0(x, "_z")]] <- (rq3_info[[x]] - rq3_scaling$center[rq3_scaling$variable == 
    x])/rq3_scaling$scale[rq3_scaling$variable == x]
rq3_data <- test_alignment %>% filter(stop_tone_alignment == "Misaligned", !missing_response, !is.na(correct)) %>% 
    transmute(participant = factor(participant), item = factor(item), condition = as.character(condition), correct = as.integer(correct), 
        vowel_family = substring(sub("_.*$", "", source_word), 2)) %>% left_join(rq3_info, by = c("condition", 
    "vowel_family"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>% mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = 1:4), vowel_family = factor(vowel_family), 
    grouping = as.numeric(condition %in% c("3", "4")), c2 = as.numeric(condition == "2"), c3 = as.numeric(condition == 
        "3"), c4 = as.numeric(condition == "4"), v2 = as.numeric(vowel_family == levels(vowel_family)[2]), v3 = as.numeric(vowel_family == 
        levels(vowel_family)[3]), v4 = as.numeric(vowel_family == levels(vowel_family)[4]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(rq3_data), all(rq3_data$correct %in% 0:1), nrow(rq3_data) == sum(model.frame(mod_rq1)$stop_tone_alignment == 
    "Misaligned"))
rq3_cells <- rq3_data %>% distinct(condition, vowel_family, f0_info_z, vot_info_z, shared_info_z)
rq3_x <- model.matrix(~vowel_family + f0_info_z + vot_info_z + shared_info_z, rq3_cells)
stopifnot(qr(rq3_x)$rank == ncol(rq3_x))
rq3_vif <- bind_rows(lapply(c("f0_info_z", "vot_info_z", "shared_info_z"), function(x) {
    rhs <- setdiff(c("vowel_family", "f0_info_z", "vot_info_z", "shared_info_z"), x)
    tibble(predictor = x, VIF = 1/(1 - summary(lm(reformulate(rhs, response = x), data = rq3_cells))$r.squared))
}))
write_csv(rq3_data, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_information_model_data.csv"))
write_csv(rq3_scaling, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_information_scaling.csv"))
write_csv(rq3_vif, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_information_collinearity.csv"))
```

```{r rq3-information-simplification}
rq3_fixed <- c(Information = "vowel_family+f0_info_z+vot_info_z+shared_info_z", Grouping = "vowel_family+grouping", 
    Categorical = "vowel_family+condition")
rq3_random <- c(maximal = "(1+v2+v3+v4|participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4|item)", independent = "(1+v2+v3+v4||participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4||item)", 
    participant_slopes = "(1+v2+v3+v4||participant)+(1|item)", item_slopes = "(1|participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4||item)", 
    intercepts = "(1|participant)+(1|item)")
rq3_selection <- tibble()
rq3_all_models <- list()
for (candidate in names(rq3_random)) for (profile in names(rq3_fixed)) {
    f <- as.formula(paste("correct~", rq3_fixed[[profile]], "+", rq3_random[[candidate]]))
    key <- list(data = as.data.frame(rq3_data), formula = paste(deparse(f), collapse = ""), maxfun = 2e+05, optimizer = "bobyqa", 
        lme4 = as.character(packageVersion("lme4")))
    path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("rq3_info_candidate_", candidate, "_", profile, ".rds"))
    old <- if (file.exists(path)) 
        readRDS(path)
    else NULL
    if (!is.null(old) && identical(key, old$key)) 
        result <- old$result
    else {
        warnings <- character()
        fit <- withCallingHandlers(tryCatch(glmer(f, data = rq3_data, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
            optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e+05))), error = function(e) e), warning = function(w) {
            warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
            invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        })
        result <- list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings))
        saveRDS(list(key = key, result = result), path)
    }
    m <- result$fit
    fitted <- inherits(m, "merMod")
    msg <- if (fitted) 
        m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
    else character()
    issues <- msg[!grepl("boundary (singular) fit", msg, fixed = TRUE)]
    converged <- fitted && length(issues) == 0 && all(m@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)
    singular <- if (fitted) 
        isSingular(m)
    else NA
    rq3_selection <- bind_rows(rq3_selection, tibble(candidate = candidate, profile = profile, random_effects = rq3_random[[candidate]], 
        converged = converged, singular = singular, eligible = fitted && converged && !singular, AIC = if (fitted) 
            AIC(m)
        else NA_real_, diagnostic = if (fitted) 
            paste(c(result$warnings, msg), collapse = "; ")
        else conditionMessage(m)))
    rq3_all_models[[paste(candidate, profile)]] <- m
    write_csv(rq3_selection, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_information_random_selection.csv"))
}
rq3_eligible <- rq3_selection %>% group_by(candidate) %>% filter(all(eligible)) %>% filter(profile == "Information") %>% 
    ungroup() %>% arrange(AIC)
if (nrow(rq3_eligible) == 0) stop("No common converged nonsingular RQ3 structure; inspect audit.")
rq3_selected_structure <- rq3_eligible$candidate[1]
rq3_models <- setNames(lapply(names(rq3_fixed), function(x) rq3_all_models[[paste(rq3_selected_structure, x)]]), 
    names(rq3_fixed))
rq3_selection <- rq3_selection %>% mutate(selected = candidate == rq3_selected_structure)
for (m in rq3_models) stopifnot(!isSingular(m), identical(getME(m, "y"), getME(rq3_models$Information, "y")), identical(getME(m, 
    "Zt"), getME(rq3_models$Information, "Zt")))
write_csv(rq3_selection, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_information_random_selection.csv"))
saveRDS(rq3_models, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_information_models.rds"))
```

```{r rq3-information-predictions}
rq3_grid <- rq3_data %>% group_by(condition, vowel_family) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup()
rq3_predictions <- bind_rows(lapply(names(rq3_models), function(nm) {
    m <- rq3_models[[nm]]
    X <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(lme4::nobars(formula(m)))), rq3_grid)
    X <- X[, names(fixef(m)), drop = FALSE]
    eta <- as.numeric(X %*% fixef(m))
    se <- sqrt(rowSums((X %*% as.matrix(vcov(m))) * X))
    tibble(model = nm, condition = rq3_grid$condition, vowel_family = rq3_grid$vowel_family, probability = plogis(eta), 
        lower = plogis(eta - 1.96 * se), upper = plogis(eta + 1.96 * se))
}))
```

```{r rq3-combined-simplification}
rq3_combined_random <- c(maximal_family = "(1+v2+v3+v4|participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4|item)+(1|vowel_family)", independent_family = "(1+v2+v3+v4||participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4||item)+(1|vowel_family)", 
    participant_family = "(1+v2+v3+v4||participant)+(1|item)+(1|vowel_family)", item_family = "(1|participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4||item)+(1|vowel_family)", 
    intercepts_family = "(1|participant)+(1|item)+(1|vowel_family)", maximal_item = "(1+v2+v3+v4|participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4|item)", 
    independent_item = "(1+v2+v3+v4||participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4||item)", participant_item = "(1+v2+v3+v4||participant)+(1|item)", 
    item_slopes = "(1|participant)+(1+c2+c3+c4||item)", intercepts = "(1|participant)+(1|item)")
rq3_combined_selection <- tibble()
rq3_combined_fits <- list()
for (candidate in names(rq3_combined_random)) {
    f <- as.formula(paste("correct~", rq3_combined_fixed, "+", rq3_combined_random[[candidate]]))
    key <- list(data = as.data.frame(rq3_data), formula = paste(deparse(f), collapse = ""), optimizer = "bobyqa", 
        maxfun = 2e+05, lme4 = as.character(packageVersion("lme4")))
    path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("rq3_combined_candidate_", candidate, ".rds"))
    old <- if (file.exists(path)) 
        readRDS(path)
    else NULL
    if (!is.null(old) && identical(old$key, key)) 
        result <- old$result
    else {
        warnings <- character()
        fit <- withCallingHandlers(tryCatch(glmer(f, data = rq3_data, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
            optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e+05))), error = function(e) e), warning = function(w) {
            warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
            invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        })
        result <- list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings))
        saveRDS(list(key = key, result = result), path)
    }
    m <- result$fit
    fitted <- inherits(m, "merMod")
    msg <- if (fitted) 
        m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
    else character()
    issues <- msg[!grepl("boundary (singular) fit", msg, fixed = TRUE)]
    converged <- fitted && length(issues) == 0 && all(m@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)
    singular <- if (fitted) 
        isSingular(m)
    else NA
    rq3_combined_selection <- bind_rows(rq3_combined_selection, tibble(candidate = candidate, random_effects = rq3_combined_random[[candidate]], 
        converged = converged, singular = singular, eligible = fitted && converged && !singular, AIC = if (fitted) 
            AIC(m)
        else NA_real_, diagnostic = if (fitted) 
            paste(c(result$warnings, msg), collapse = "; ")
        else conditionMessage(m)))
    rq3_combined_fits[[candidate]] <- m
    write_csv(rq3_combined_selection, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_combined_random_selection.csv"))
}
rq3_combined_eligible <- rq3_combined_selection %>% filter(eligible) %>% arrange(AIC)
if (nrow(rq3_combined_eligible) == 0) stop("Combined RQ3 has no converged nonsingular candidate.")
rq3_combined_selected <- rq3_combined_eligible$candidate[1]
mod_rq3_combined <- rq3_combined_fits[[rq3_combined_selected]]
rq3_combined_selection <- rq3_combined_selection %>% mutate(selected = candidate == rq3_combined_selected)
write_csv(rq3_combined_selection, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_combined_random_selection.csv"))
saveRDS(mod_rq3_combined, file.path(output_dir, "rq3_combined_model.rds"))
```

```{r rq4-random-selection-setup}
rq4_select <- function(d, fixed, candidates, label) {
    stopifnot(!anyNA(d), !anyDuplicated(d[c("participant", "cue_type")]))
    audit <- tibble()
    fits <- list()
    for (candidate in names(candidates)) {
        f <- as.formula(paste("dprime~", fixed, "+", candidates[[candidate]]))
        key <- list(data = as.data.frame(d), formula = paste(deparse(f), collapse = ""), REML = FALSE, optimizer = "bobyqa", 
            maxfun = 2e+05, lme4 = as.character(packageVersion("lme4")))
        path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(label, "_candidate_", candidate, ".rds"))
        old <- if (file.exists(path)) 
            readRDS(path)
        else NULL
        if (!is.null(old) && identical(old$key, key)) 
            result <- old$result
        else {
            warnings <- character()
            fit <- withCallingHandlers(tryCatch(lmer(f, data = d, REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
                optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e+05))), error = function(e) e), warning = function(w) {
                warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
                invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
            })
            result <- list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings))
            saveRDS(list(key = key, result = result), path)
        }
        m <- result$fit
        fitted <- inherits(m, "merMod")
        msg <- if (fitted) 
            m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
        else character()
        issues <- msg[!grepl("boundary (singular) fit", msg, fixed = TRUE)]
        converged <- fitted && length(issues) == 0 && all(m@optinfo$conv$opt == 0)
        singular <- if (fitted) 
            isSingular(m)
        else NA
        audit <- bind_rows(audit, tibble(candidate = candidate, random_effects = candidates[[candidate]], converged = converged, 
            singular = singular, eligible = fitted && converged && !singular, AIC = if (fitted) 
                AIC(m)
            else NA_real_, diagnostic = if (fitted) 
                paste(c(result$warnings, msg), collapse = "; ")
            else conditionMessage(m)))
        fits[[candidate]] <- m
    }
    eligible <- audit %>% filter(eligible) %>% arrange(AIC)
    if (nrow(eligible) == 0) 
        stop(paste(label, "has no converged nonsingular candidate"))
    selected <- eligible$candidate[1]
    model <- fits[[selected]]
    audit$selected <- audit$candidate == eligible$candidate[1]
    write_csv(audit, file.path(output_dir, paste0(label, "_random_selection.csv")))
    saveRDS(model, file.path(output_dir, paste0(label, "_model.rds")))
    list(model = model, selection = audit)
}
rq4a_candidates <- c(correlated_vot = "(1+vot|participant)+(0+stopless|participant)", correlated_stopless = "(1+stopless|participant)+(0+vot|participant)", 
    correlated_slopes = "(1|participant)+(0+stopless+vot|participant)", independent = "(1+stopless+vot||participant)", 
    vot_only = "(1+vot||participant)", stopless_only = "(1+stopless||participant)", intercept = "(1|participant)")
rq4b_candidates <- c(independent = "(1+stopless||participant)", intercept = "(1|participant)")
```

```{r rq4-combined-coefficients}
    condition4 = "Condition 4 vs. Condition 1", `cue_typeF0 stopless` = "F0 stopless vs. F0 intact", cue_typeVOT = "VOT vs. F0 intact", 
    tone_centered = "Lexical tone use (F0 intact)", `condition2:cue_typeF0 stopless` = "C2 vs. C1 × F0 stopless vs. intact", 
    `condition3:cue_typeF0 stopless` = "C3 vs. C1 × F0 stopless vs. intact", `condition4:cue_typeF0 stopless` = "C4 vs. C1 × F0 stopless vs. intact", 
    `condition2:cue_typeVOT` = "C2 vs. C1 × VOT vs. F0 intact", `condition3:cue_typeVOT` = "C3 vs. C1 × VOT vs. F0 intact",
```

```{r rq4-combined-output}
rq4_combined_slopes <- as.data.frame(summary(emtrends(mod_rq4_combined, ~cue_type, var = "tone_centered", lmer.df = "asymptotic"), 
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "holm")) %>% mutate(stars = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "***", p.value < 0.01 ~ 
    "**", p.value < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns"))
rq4_combined_grid <- rq4_combined_data %>% group_by(condition, cue_type) %>% summarise(misaligned_tone = list(seq(min(misaligned_tone), 
    max(misaligned_tone), length.out = 100)), .groups = "drop") %>% unnest(misaligned_tone) %>% mutate(tone_centered = misaligned_tone - 
    rq4_combined_center)
rq4_combined_X <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(lme4::nobars(formula(mod_rq4_combined)))), rq4_combined_grid, 
    contrasts.arg = attr(getME(mod_rq4_combined, "X"), "contrasts"))
rq4_combined_grid$estimate <- as.vector(rq4_combined_X %*% fixef(mod_rq4_combined))
rq4_combined_grid$SE <- sqrt(rowSums((rq4_combined_X %*% as.matrix(vcov(mod_rq4_combined))) * rq4_combined_X))
rq4_combined_grid <- rq4_combined_grid %>% mutate(lower = estimate - qnorm(0.975) * SE, upper = estimate + qnorm(0.975) * 
    SE)
rq4_combined_annotations <- rq4_combined_slopes %>% mutate(label = sprintf("Tone-use slope: %.2f %s", tone_centered.trend, 
    stars))
write_csv(rq4_combined_slopes, file.path(output_dir, "rq4_combined_slopes.csv"))
write_csv(rq4_combined_grid, file.path(output_dir, "rq4_combined_predictions.csv"))
```

```{r ax-stopless-extension}
ax_paired_ids <- ax_scores %>% filter(cue_type %in% c("F0 intact", "F0 stopless")) %>% group_by(participant) %>% 
    summarise(tasks = n_distinct(cue_type), .groups = "drop") %>% filter(tasks == 2)
ax_paired <- ax_scores %>% semi_join(ax_paired_ids, by = "participant") %>% filter(cue_type %in% c("F0 intact", 
    "F0 stopless"), is.finite(dprime)) %>% mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4")), 
    cue_type = droplevels(cue_type))
stopifnot(all(count(ax_paired, participant)$n == 2))

    "F0 stopless"))

names(ax_stopless_weights) <- paste0("C", 1:4, ": stopless minus intact")

ax_stopless_out <- as.data.frame(summary(contrast(ax_stopless_emm, ax_stopless_weights), infer = c(FALSE, TRUE), 
    adjust = "holm"))
```
